concreteIssuesFixed.issue: Size-free legacy downloads used an unbounded arrayBuffer read, and absent decoded sizes allowed unbounded decompression before validation.
concreteIssuesFixed.resolution: Legacy packed-size omission now uses capped streaming with cancellation; every decode requires a valid expectedBytes before fetching. Existing v19 tests continue to decode their real files.

concreteIssuesFixed.issue: Malformed part URLs or a worker postMessage failure could leave a newly constructed worker alive.
concreteIssuesFixed.resolution: Resolve and validate transport URLs before worker construction, then terminate any current worker in the request failure handler.

concreteIssuesFixed.issue: A seed build with public R2 serving enabled would intercept the previous fine-surface URLs before those objects were populated.
concreteIssuesFixed.resolution: Staging rejects seed mode unless public serving is false, and rejects final mode unless public serving is true. Gate changes still require rebuilding the Site.

concreteIssuesFixed.issue: Seed staging skipped integrity and existence checks on the v19 static build copies it intended to retain.
concreteIssuesFixed.resolution: Seed staging now requires both retained build files to exist and match their source-index byte counts and checksums.

transportLimits.note: These are individual transport and decoded-buffer limits, not an aggregate browser memory budget.

validation.coverage: Matching, mismatched and unreadable gates; missing, altered and matching retained seed files

releaseRequirements: Seed: disable public serving, enable only the new collection upload gate, rebuild, and stage with --seed.
Upload and verify every indexed part through actual API GET checksums.

Final: close the new upload gate, enable public serving, populate data-gentle-download-mb from the final compressed byte count, enable data-gentle-ready only after verification, rebuild, and stage without --seed.
Run the uploader's read-only verification against public URLs and confirm PUT rejection after the final release.
limitations: This review and its local fixtures do not constitute a live upload or live publication verification.
Final scientific mesh quality, actual device memory demand, and interactive rendering performance require separate evidence.
